title: Disputes Desk Basis: Which Utility Charges Are Held While a Dispute Is Submitted
content:
# Charges Held During a Submitted Dispute — Utility Services Program

**Basis.** When a bill line of a Utility Services Program account stands under the most recent dispute in submitted status, the held charges depend on the ground of that dispute:

- **Suspected leak, with a matching sewer line.** When the dispute is a suspected leak and the account's most recent sewer usage line bills the same metered usage as the disputed line, the held charges are the disputed line and that sewer line together.
- **Meter accuracy.** When it is a meter accuracy dispute, the held charges are every water usage line issued fewer than two whole months before the payment date.
- **Every other situation.** The held charges are the disputed line alone.

Amounts are taken as billed and summed to the cent.

## Ground of the dispute and the lines held

| Ground recorded on the dispute | Condition | Lines held |
|---|---|---|
| suspected leak | most recent sewer usage line bills the same usage as the disputed line | disputed line and that sewer line |
| suspected leak | most recent sewer usage line bills a different usage | disputed line alone |
| meter accuracy | — | every water usage line issued in the two whole months before the payment date |
| estimated read, occupant count or calculation error | — | disputed line alone |

## Cases (hypothetical lines)

- A suspected-leak dispute names a water line of 12.300 thousand gallons billed at $102.95; the most recent sewer line bills 12.300 thousand gallons at $123.87. Held: $226.82.
- A meter accuracy dispute; water usage lines of $61.20 and $58.75 were issued in the last two whole months. Held: $119.95.
- An occupant count dispute naming a $44.10 line. Held: $44.10.
